name: Anafa Cohen
title: Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
tagline: Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
bio: I'm a Senior Computer Vision & ML Engineer with 7 years of experience designing and deploying production-grade AI systems in agriculture, sports analytics, satellite imagery, and speech processing. I take ownership of end-to-end pipelines — from data strategy and modeling to benchmarking, optimization, and deployment. I bring a strong background in applied mathematics and physics.

statement: I'm a machine learning engineer who enjoys turning messy, real-world data into working algorithms.

With 7+ years of experience in computer vision and applied machine learning, I work on problems involving imagery, video, audio, and other sensor data — from the first experiment to a solution that actually works in production.

roles.title: Senior Computer Vision & Deep Learning Engineer
description: Designed and implemented a closed-vocabulary object detection module based on a Co-DETR pre-trained model, including full benchmarking and evaluation pipeline.
Built a comprehensive benchmarking framework to evaluate model performance and guide architectural and threshold-level decisions.
Enhanced an end-to-end License Plate Recognition (LPR) pipeline, including detection, OCR, and clustering, through systematic threshold tuning and ablation studies.
Improved speaker recognition capabilities by refining speaker diarization, generating representative embeddings, and enabling efficient large-scale embedding retrieval.
Worked closely with product and engineering teams to integrate models into production systems.

roles.title: Computer Vision & Deep Learning Engineer
description: Developed object detection and image classification models for large-scale drone imagery in agricultural environments.
Led the development of an end-to-end pipeline for early-stage detection of field crops such as sugar beet and cotton.
Managed a proof-of-concept for wide-field imagery to improve weed detection, including data analysis, annotation guidelines, and evaluation of multiple annotation strategies.
Designed and trained CNN-based crop classification models, handling the full lifecycle from data preparation and training to production deployment.

roles.title: Computer Vision & Deep Learning Engineer
description: Developed real-time computer vision algorithms for automatic sports broadcast production.
Improved game state detection in American Football videos by analyzing failure modes of existing algorithms and incorporating motion-based and spatial metrics.
Conducted research and rapid prototyping in Python and deployed optimized solutions in C++ for real-time performance.

roles.title: Computer Vision & Deep Learning Engineer
description: Developed deep learning and classical image processing algorithms for radar (SAR) and optical satellite imagery in agricultural applications.
Led semantic segmentation project for crop-type classification using satellite data.
Applied machine learning techniques, classical image processing, and statistical methods to satellite imagery for flood detection and crop-type classification.
